name: The Social Change Nest
summary: UK community interest company that hosts community and grassroots groups without a legal entity, climate groups among them.

evidence.quote: Are a community group, or grassroots organisation that has a social impact
From mutual aid networks and climate justice initiatives to racial equity and health & wellness advocates, we support a diverse range of groups working towards social change.
Registered office: C/O Sedulo Office 605, Albert House 256-260 Old Street, London, England
We are registered as a community interest company (CIC).

projects.value: Community and grassroots groups with a social impact; climate justice groups among those it hosts

evidence.quote: From mutual aid networks and climate justice initiatives to racial equity and health & wellness advocates, we support a diverse range of groups working towards social change.

where.value: Some groups that work outside the UK

evidence.quote: We support some groups that work outside of the UK.
Are a group or individual that's making social change

value.note: mostly groups without a legal entity

evidence.quote: Are unincorporated (In most cases. If you are incorporated e.g. a registered charity, CIC or limited company, contact us to discuss).

fees.value: £42 once, after the first money arrives

evidence.quote: A one-time £42 fee, charged only after you successfully receive your first funds.

fees.value: 5% of incoming money other than grants

evidence.quote: 5% on all incoming funds (excluding grants).

fees.value: 7-15% of grants it signs for, by complexity

evidence.quote: 7-15% on grants which we sign on your behalf. The rate is determined by complexity and administrative requirements of the grant.

fees.value: More for groups that work outside the UK

evidence.quote: We support some groups that work outside of the UK. Our fees for this kind of support are higher, due to the extra admin on our side and the costs associated with international transfers.

value.note: It can help sign the grant agreement, or provide a letter of intent.

evidence.quote: We can help sign your grant agreement or provide you with a letter of intent.

value.note: payroll service: salaries, payroll taxes, pensions and NI

evidence.quote: We handle all aspects of payroll, including: Salaries, Payroll taxes, Pension contributions and NI contributions.
We won't be able to accept your application without a second admin.

conditions.value: Donors get no UK tax relief for now

evidence.quote: Until this registration is complete, we unfortunately cannot offer these tax breaks.
Submit an application Book in an onboarding call
Book in an onboarding call where a member of our team will ask you some questions about your group and show you how the platform works.

steps.value: Open Collective page with a second administrator and an expense policy

evidence.quote: You'll need to set up a page on Open Collective. Make sure you add a second admin and upload an expense policy.

steps.value: Due diligence, then live; as little as 2 weeks

evidence.quote: it can take as little as 2 weeks. Once you've completed the necessary steps (see application process above), and we've completed our due diligence, we can take you live.

form_asks.value: A clear social purpose and evidence of your activity

evidence.quote: Evidence of your activity. This could be social media accounts, photos, videos, etc.
An expenses policy. Check out our guidance and examples of expenses policies.

form_asks.value: A safeguarding policy, if you work with vulnerable people

evidence.quote: A safeguarding policy if you're working with vulnerable people.
